nameOrigin: device producing light, usually via a flame

pokedexEntries.bk: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

pokedexEntries.wh: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

pokedexEntries.as: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.

pokedexEntries.sw: This Pokémon appears just before someone passes away, so it’s feared as an emissary of death.

pokedexEntries.sh: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

pokedexEntries.sc: Lampent appears at the moment of death and promptly absorbs the spirit as it leaves the body.
